Container.Name: pia-iptv
Container.Overview:
PIA VPN gateway for IPTV, with a kill switch.
Other containers (such as m3u-editor) join this container's network and reach the internet only through Private Internet Access. If the tunnel drops, their traffic is blocked instead of leaking your real IP.
• WireGuard (default) or OpenVPN, any PIA region • Kill switch: IPv4 locked to the tunnel, IPv6 blocked • Reconnects in place; re-registers the WireGuard key with server failover • Only the ports you list are reachable from your LAN
Install this first, then "m3u-editor (via pia-iptv)". The app's ports are published HERE, because it lives in this container's network.
Container.Requires: A Private Internet Access subscription. /dev/net/tun on the server (check with: ls -l /dev/net/tun).

Config.Name: m3u-editor port
Config.Description: Web UI and Xtream server of the app that joins this container (m3u-editor). TiviMate connects here.

Config.Name: PIA region
Config.Description: Region id or name, e.g. us_california, us_west, ca_vancouver, netherlands. Pick one near you or near your IPTV provider.

Config.Name: VPN client
Config.Description: WireGuard is faster and better for 4K.

Config.Name: LAN network
Config.Description: Only these LAN ranges may reach the app ports (comma-separated). Empty = any source on the container network.

Config.Name: LAN ports
Config.Description: App ports opened through the kill switch (comma-separated). Keep in step with the port mappings above.

Config.Name: DNS servers
Config.Description: Resolvers used through the tunnel, shared with containers that join this one.
